field_text_formatted.value: OpenAPI schema export crashed with jsonapi_views enabled (#3265781). jsonapi_views now reports a view's real ResourceType on the route when its entity type has exactly one bundle, so OpenAPI describes it correctly; multi-bundle views are left alone.
